topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I mean, I don’t know what to think right now. Finding out Alex has been writing a whole novel about me—it's a lot. On one hand, it’s kind of the sweetest thing, you know? Like, they’ve been thinking about us, about everything we’ve been through, and putting it down on paper. But on the other hand, it’s got me spinning. What if there’s stuff in there I don’t recognize? What if it’s all twisted up in their head, or worse, what if it’s too close to the truth? I guess I just need to talk to them, right? But, I don’t know, maybe I’m overthinking this. What does it all mean, really?
